# Lucky Luke Magic

> Family magic shows by Lucky Luke Magic in Vancouver, WA and Portland, OR. The photo library lists accepted photos from the shoots, with how each photo was categorized and rated, and every version available to download.

The site is a Blazor WebAssembly app, so most pages need JavaScript. The photo library is server-rendered and does not.

## Photo library

- [Photo library (interactive)](https://lukehammer.com/photos): filter by category and rating, and sort, in the browser.
- [Photo library (HTML)](https://lukehammer.com/api/photoreview/library): every accepted photo, grouped by category, with ratings and download links.
- [Photo library (JSON)](https://lukehammer.com/api/photoreview/library/data): the same photos as data for tools and scripts. Filters: `category` (slug), `minRating` (1-10), `current` (true/false), `sort` (category, rating, newest, title). Example: https://lukehammer.com/api/photoreview/library/data?category=headshots&sort=rating
- [Photo library manifest (JSON)](https://lukehammer.com/api/photoreview/library/manifest): older flat format used by the sync tool.

Field descriptions are included in the JSON response under `fieldDescriptions`. Capture details such as camera and settings are not published.
